intended_object: A helper that, for a position in the proof-search game where Builder moves (a node of the coalgebra being built from a winning Prover strategy), lists the successor nodes (premises). It is used to define the coalgebra structure map `α` in the completeness proof for GL.
explanation: The definition is an internal step in the completeness proof. It builds the list of child nodes (using `repNext` and `nextNext` for repeated and fresh sequents) for each rule application. It is used only in the definition of the coalgebra map `α g := ⟨builderRuleApp g.1 g.2.2, builderMovePremises g h⟩` and in the proofs about that map. It has no standalone counterpart in the literature or in Mathlib, so it is a technical device and not a mathematical object to compare against.
